Greetings,

I am gsoc aspirant Venali Sonone, a BTech CSE student at Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute (VJTI),Mumbai,India 
and I am highly passionate and excited to work on DeepLearnR tensorFlow Object system for R.
The solutions to test are posted on project page.

My previous experience is working on wide range of technology:
1. embedded system(embedded coder for robocon'15 team VJTI india in internationals)
2. Augmented Reality(Research intern at MIT-India initiative )
3. Data Analyst(working with Barclay as intern)

I have hands on experience with R and quite a lot of r packages. I have been previously working on in-memory issues of R 
and creating an opensource version of Revolution R Enterprise ScaleR while working in corporate.
I am very much inclined towards open source and i want to make some contribution to community which motivates me as gsoc aspirant.

I have acquired skills of r via cloud-era training and self study. Along with it i enhanced skills in domain by taking courses 
Introduction to Algorithms MIT Course Number:6.046
Artificial Intelligence MIT Course Number:6.034
john hopkins data science specialization coursera

I request your kind assistance and guidance henceforth and looking forward to student applications.


Warm Regards,
Venali Sonone
